name: prompt-333
image_vibe: Playful East-Asian social portrait with crisp flash shadows, pink accents, and clean beauty styling
image_purpose: Create a vertical social-media fashion portrait with direct-flash editorial character.

prompt.project_info: A vertical mid-thigh-to-head high-key direct-flash portrait of an original adult East Asian woman seated casually on a black leather sofa.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult East Asian woman with a slim natural build, long dark-brown hair in a messy high updo with loose strands and curtain bangs, a playful wink, and a small beauty mark under the left eye. She wears a fitted white cropped camisole, a light-gray zip hoodie open and slightly slipping off both shoulders, and white lounge shorts, with bare feet. Keep the expression playful and the styling non-explicit.
prompt.composition_elements: Central seated pose on a black leather sofa against a plain white or light-gray wall, legs crossed and tucked close, right hand supporting the chin and lower cheek, head tilted about five degrees, silver laptop positioned on the sofa cushion to camera-left with its Apple logo visible, vertical mid-thigh-to-head crop with room above the hair.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct hard flash near the camera axis, slightly camera-right and above eye level, crisp dark cast shadows on the wall, strong controlled specular highlights on the skin and sofa leather, suppressed ambient light, bright clean slightly cool tone with emphasized pink makeup accents.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame digital camera look, 50mm prime lens, ISO 100, f/4, 5800K white balance, eye-level vertical framing, moderate depth of field focused near the right eye, high-key direct-flash social photography, natural skin texture and realistic fabric/leather detail, no extra text or watermark beyond the specified laptop logo.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic vertical mid-thigh-to-head high-key direct-flash portrait of an original adult East Asian woman seated casually on a black leather sofa against a plain white or light-gray wall. Give her a slim natural build, long dark-brown hair in a messy high updo with loose strands and curtain bangs, a playful wink, a small beauty mark under the left eye, stylized K-Beauty/Douyin-inspired makeup with pink blush, pink gradient lips, defined brows, light eyeliner, and subtle aegyo-sal. Dress her in a fitted white cropped camisole, an open light-gray zip hoodie slightly slipping off both shoulders, and white lounge shorts, with bare feet. Cross and tuck the legs close, raise the right hand with fingers loosely curled to support the chin and lower cheek, tilt the head about five degrees, and place a silver laptop on the sofa cushion to camera-left with its Apple logo visible. Use direct hard flash near the camera axis slightly camera-right and above eye level, crisp cast shadows on the wall, controlled highlights on skin and leather, 50mm prime lens, ISO 100, f/4, 5800K white balance, moderate depth of field focused near the right eye, bright slightly cool high-key color, realistic skin and fabric texture, and no extra text or watermark beyond the specified laptop logo.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, fused fingers, plastic skin, poreless retouching, over-smooth, harsh artifacts, extreme wide-angle distortion, unapproved logos, extra text, watermark

assets.name: silver laptop with specified Apple logo
assets.usage: Use optional guidance for the laptop's silver form and camera-left sofa placement; retain the specified Apple logo only when the product reference is available.

assets.name: source direct-flash seated portrait
assets.usage: Use optional guidance for the sofa pose, direct-flash shadows, pink makeup, white-gray environment, and vertical social portrait framing.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult subject, seated sofa pose, direct wink, white camisole and gray hoodie, laptop placement, direct-flash shadows, and clean social portrait mood. The laptop is optional; if attached, preserve its placement and specified logo. Identity may vary.

Retained the specified non-explicit outfit, pose, laptop, and flash aesthetic.
